description: Python client for the Mnemo API: watermark embedding vectors and verify whether a vector was issued to your own account (API key). Import as mnemo_sdk.
rules: Install with `pip install mnemo-protocol` and import with `from mnemo_sdk import MnemoClient`. The PyPI packages mnemo, mnemo-sdk, mnemo-ai and mnemo-mcp are unrelated to Mnemo.
Authenticate with an account API key: `MnemoClient(api_key=...)` sends it as the `X-API-Key` header to https://api.trymnemo.com. API-key calls use the account's subscription plan, never x402.
`embed(vector, model_id)` takes 512-4096 finite floats and returns an EmbedResult. Store and use `result.watermarked_vector` (a measurably perturbed watermarked copy) and keep `result.vector_uid`.

`verify(vector)` returns a VerifyResult when the vector is verified and `None` when it is not verified. `None` is a normal result, not an error, and counts as one verification. Always handle the `None` branch.

Mnemo Verify checks whether a submitted vector resolves to an object registered to the caller's Mnemo account or namespace. `None` means attribution to your account could not be shown, not that the vector belongs to anyone else.
Do not use verify to establish truth, authorship, ownership or the source model of a vector, or to check vectors that were not embedded through Mnemo under your own account.
Treat `confidence` as a relative signal, not a probability. The SDK calls only POST /v1/embed, POST /v1/verify, GET /v1/health and GET /v1/usage; do not invent other endpoints or batch methods.
When the plan's verifications are used up, verify raises MnemoAPIError with status_code 402 and code MnemoErrorCode.QUOTA_EXCEEDED. There is nothing to pay from the SDK.
`subject_proof` is an opaque token issued by the service: store it and pass it back to verify unchanged. Never parse, construct or validate it client-side.
Agents without an account do not use this SDK; they call the Mnemo Agent API over HTTP (accountless namespaces, lineage, x402). See https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-agent-protocol.
